name: vm_native_q1core_r4

job.purpose: SE/NE core-only VM bank (H-NETLIST d4f 1b42352f8: q1 master with dq, rq1/rq2, wq1 absent) native closure for the vmb_SE/NE0..7 hoist.
job.structural_change: q1_core (H-NETLIST d4f bdd023804 contract; RTL identical to 1b42352f8) on RECIPE 4 (die boundary hold budget, flop-first pins, no inhold/outhold pads) and the nat2 geometry (270x270 abutted SRAM stack, spine clock). Every data pin registered: inputs +1 edge (as nat2), outputs +1 edge (NEW vs nat2: read return / egress / done one edge later).

pin_regs.reason: recipe 4 (FLOW-HOLD, H-DIE 10-16): every data pin registered by ot_pin_regs; outputs were already RTL registers, so rr*/eg/pr/status/*_done carry +1 edge vs q1 nat2 (inputs +1 as nat2)
